name: Math Dash Ninja
author: Addicting Games
description: Math Dash Ninja is a free dash game. Remember that math is an ancient art which is also an ancient science. When the power of math is combined with the power of free games you get a true synthesis of fun and entertainment: we call it funtertainment. Math Dash Ninja is a math game where players are forced to answer math questions in order to activate their fun ninja friend as he runs, dodges, and jumps his way through an obstacle course filled with lasers, bombs, bottomless pits, spikes, and other cool but totally dangerous threats. Your ninja's ability to survive this run will be dependent upon your ability to correctly answer the math questions at the bottom of the screen. This game will both challenge your math skills as well as help you build them. Choose which grade level and skill type you'd like to work on and then enter the arena as a Ninja superstar who is ambitious and ready to take on the world. This game is a fun and exciting way to practice your ninja skills, your math skills, and your gaming skills. We are happy to provide this service to you.
